t: A handheld radio scanner and transmitter covering 1 MHz to 6 GHz.
steps: Order PortaRF from the OpenSourceSDRLab store for about 220 US dollars, or with the AI MDK board for about 255.
Charge it over USB-C and screw on the telescopic antenna.
Read the Quick Start Guide in the PortaRF GitHub repo.
Power on and open a receive app such as the FM radio or the spectrum view.
Take it outside and try the ADS-B app to spot planes.
Update the firmware from the microSD card with the Flash Utility.
Learn your local radio rules before you try any transmit app.
